mentions.name: Software House
mentions.description: Governance layer for AI tooling built by employees inside organizations. Provides a central home for scattered internal HTML files, secures them, and puts OIDC authentication in front of them.
mentions.problem: Employee-built AI tools exist as scattered HTML files flying all over the place, with no security and no home.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://getsoftwarehouse.com - I'm also working on the governance layer for AI tooling that is being built by employees, there's just HTML files flying all over the place, no security, no home. So built software house as a place for these things to live, be secured, put OIDC in front etc.
